metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds Joan on the feet, the Lammas table, the salt water, and evening prayer.

yesterday: Joan called the feet a disgrace in the morning.
Hamnet Sadler sent the loaf, the size the assize allows. Your mother gave you the heel.
You told your father the horse was dear.
The rye is in, and light. Edmund helped turn it. The wheat at Shottery stands thin. The barley stopped short of a figure.
Richard's words at the meal were that the weather will hold. Evening prayer was the ordinary prayers, and your feet were in salt water before church.
